what-types-of-bundles.question: What types of bundles can I create with PushBundle?
what-types-of-bundles.answer: You can create mix-and-match (build-a-box) bundles, volume/quantity-tier bundles, fixed product bundles, and cross-sell bundles — all without code.

shopper-chosen-variants.question: Can shoppers choose their own product variants for a bundle?
shopper-chosen-variants.answer: Yes. Shoppers build their own pack by picking variants, while you control pack size, per-variant quantity limits, and which variants are eligible.

bundle-discounts.question: Does PushBundle support discounts for bundles?
bundle-discounts.answer: Yes — percentage or fixed discounts, discounts on a fixed quantity, and custom quantity ranges. You can also apply a flat total discount or a per-variant discount.

easy-to-set-up.question: Is PushBundle easy to set up on my Shopify store?
easy-to-set-up.answer: Install from the Shopify App Store, enable the app embed, and add the PushBundle app block to your theme. A guided setup walks you through it.

limit-to-collections.question: Can I limit bundle discounts to specific collections or products?
limit-to-collections.answer: Yes. Bundles can be targeted by collection, product, tag, vendor, or product type, and restricted to specific customers or customer tags.

free-plan.question: Is there a free plan?
free-plan.answer: Yes — the Starter plan is free forever and includes volume bundles, discount rules, display styles, and live preview.

free-trial.question: How does the 14-day free trial work?
free-trial.answer: Every new store gets a 14-day free trial with full access to the Growth plan. You are not charged until the trial ends.

shopify-plus-pos.question: Does PushBundle work with Shopify Plus, POS, and Markets?
shopify-plus-pos.answer: Yes. PushBundle works with Checkout, Shopify POS, Shopify Admin, and Markets (multi-currency), and is Built for Shopify.
